policy.principle: Every material SEO change must have a measurable hypothesis, a pre-change baseline, an owner query/page, a protected observation window, and a keep/revise/revert decision based on finalized Search Console evidence.
avoid: multiple major variables on the same page at once
changing pages already performing well without evidence
evidenceOrder: repeat competitor patterns across winning pages
policy.activeExperimentRule: Do not make speculative content rewrites to pages in a running experiment before its evaluateNotBefore date. Technical, factual, contact, indexability or safety corrections are allowed and must be logged.

experiments.hypothesis: Reducing broad generic appliance-pickup language on refrigerator/freezer specialty pages will concentrate broad city intent on the general Rancho Cucamonga page while preserving specialty-page relevance.
experiments.change: Narrowed specialty-page body language and parent anchors so refrigerator/freezer pages describe only their appliance-specific intent and direct mixed/multi-appliance requests to the city owner page.
successSignals: Broad Rancho queries increasingly consolidate on /rancho-cucamonga-appliance-pickup/
General page broad-query average position improves without specialty-query loss
Specialty pages retain or improve refrigerator/freezer-specific impressions

experiments.hypothesis: Reciprocal internal links between the commercial authority hub and priority city pages will improve discovery and relevance for commercial/recurring intent while strengthening city pages with a real topical support layer.

baseline.commercialProgramSignal: No selected commercial-program page appeared in the returned top-page/query relationship rows for this finalized period.

experiments.change: Added reciprocal commercial/recurring internal-link pathways between the main commercial hub and Phoenix, Fresno and Sacramento; expanded commercial hub market links while keeping partner-recruiting markets clearly qualified.
successSignals: New impressions/queries for commercial, recurring, property-manager or senior-living program pages
Improved city-page impressions/position for commercially relevant queries without harming core residential queries
More consistent internal-link discovery between priority cities and commercial program pages

experiments.hypothesis: Direct links from the main washer/dryer hub to priority local laundry pages will strengthen topical concentration and improve discovery of those city laundry pages without creating new thin pages.

baseline.globalHubSignal: The global /washer-dryer-pickup/ page did not appear in the returned GSC top-page/query relationship rows for the finalized period.

priorityLaundrySignal.query: "salem-keizer recycling & transfer station" "3250 deer park dr se"

baseline.architectureGap: Before the change, the main washer/dryer hub had no direct links detected to the priority local laundry pages in Rancho Cucamonga, Fontana, Fresno, Phoenix, Denver, Portland, Salem, Sacramento or Coachella Valley.

experiments.change: Added a priority-market bridge from the nationwide washer/dryer hub to nine strategically important local/regional laundry pages.
successSignals: The global washer/dryer hub begins receiving impressions for generic laundry-pickup queries
Priority city laundry pages gain new impressions or improve average position for washer/dryer-specific queries
No increase in general-vs-laundry cannibalization on the corresponding city appliance pages

experiments.hypothesis: Stronger city-specific trust, access/disposal detail and city-to-appliance hub links will increase qualified impressions and improve city/appliance query positions without creating thin city copies.

baseline.note: Other priority Coachella pages lacked enough finalized impressions for a stable average baseline.

experiments.change: Strengthened Palm Springs, Palm Desert and La Quinta conversion/local-usefulness blocks; lightly protected Indio; strengthened regional appliance, laundry and refrigerator hubs; corrected Coachella specialty contact consistency to 909-375-6685.
successSignals: New Palm Springs/Palm Desert/La Quinta query impressions
Improved Indio/Cathedral City position without loss of clicks
New washer/dryer and refrigerator-specific Coachella impressions
No uniqueness/routing regressions

experiments.hypothesis: Clear general-vs-laundry intent ownership plus verified local alternatives will concentrate broad Denver appliance queries on the city page while the laundry page owns washer/dryer-only searches.
experiments.change: Separated laundry-only intent from the Denver city page, repaired the dedicated laundry link, synchronized search metadata/schema, and added current city/utility alternatives.
successSignals: More Denver broad-query impressions consolidate on city page
Exact Denver queries improve
Laundry-only queries consolidate on laundry page
CTR improves from zero

experiments.hypothesis: Clear Phoenix city ownership plus separate metro/laundry intent will reduce overlap and improve Phoenix city-query relevance.
experiments.change: Corrected Phoenix contact to 602-726-7552, separated city/general from metro and laundry intent, and synchronized metadata/schema.
successSignals: Phoenix city query impressions increase
Exact Phoenix query position improves
Wrong-page overlap declines
Laundry queries consolidate on laundry page

experiments.hypothesis: A clearer qualification-and-local-availability snippet will convert already-high-position homepage impressions into clicks without sacrificing average position.
experiments.change: Rewrote the homepage meta description around free appliance pickup qualification, ZIP/local availability and major appliance intent; synchronized WebPage schema.
successSignals: Homepage clicks > 0
Homepage CTR improves
Homepage average position remains competitive
Generic query ownership becomes clearer

experiments.market: San Gabriel Valley / eastern corridor CTR test
experiments.hypothesis: For city pages already ranking roughly positions 7-10 with impressions but zero clicks, a clearer 'free to submit + no account + text photos/call' meta description will improve CTR without materially hurting average position.
experiments.change: Changed only the meta/OG/WebPage description on the three test pages; titles and on-page content were left unchanged to isolate search-snippet conversion effects.
successSignals: Test-group CTR becomes positive or materially exceeds control-group CTR
Test-group impressions remain stable or increase
Average position does not materially deteriorate relative to controls
